notes: Designer decision (Oct 2026), replacing the book's minor/major split (STA 2e Quickstart p. 23-24): every combatant (party and enemies) starts each turn with actionPoints AP; each action costs apCost. Any action except Move may be repeated in a turn (e.g. Attack + Attack). First pass implements Move, Aim, Attack and End Turn.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): Move is once per turn and goes up to the character's full movement allowance (Fitness-based); unused tiles are lost.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): at 0 AP the turn ends by itself (to the next party member with AP, else onward). End Turn (free) ends a turn with AP left.
Designer decision (Oct 2026), following the book (STA 2e Quickstart p. 22): there is no Take Cover action. A unit next to a cover object is in cover automatically (removed from the mockup's panel).
panel: the actions shown in the Actions panel, in mockup order. The others are defined for later passes.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): Attack and Aim are not in the panel. Clicking an enemy shows buttons around it: Stun and Deadly (fire at once), Aim, Use Item and Info. Clicking a party member shows Assist (and Switch, to hand them the turn).
Designer request (Oct 2026): clicking the acting character shows their own actions around them (selfRing, in order). Actions not implemented yet are shown disabled until their rules are approved.

actions.name: Move
actions.description: Once per turn: walk up to your full movement. End next to a cover object to be in cover.

actions.name: Aim
actions.description: Reroll one die on your next attack this turn; both dice (each once) with a focus that fits the weapon.

actions.name: Sprint
actions.description: Once per turn, before or after Move: run up to half your movement (rounded up), no roll. End next to a cover object to be in cover.
notes: Book: Captain's Log has no Sprint action; Fitness covers moving 'quickly around the battlefield' (p. 75) and its dash example rolls Fitness + Security (p. 205). The STA 2e Quickstart is not in reference/, so its Sprint is unchecked.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): 1 AP, no roll, ceil(movement / 2) tiles, once per turn before or after Move; everyone (party and Klingons) and every AI can use it. Not an attack, so it doesn't end the Ambush chance.

actions.name: Assist
actions.description: Pick an ally who still has a turn this round. Their next attack adds your 1d20; its success counts if they score at least one.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: Once, until anyone attacks: the party member with the best Control + Security rolls at Difficulty 1 against a Klingon they could shoot (Camouflage or Ambush Tactics rerolls a failed die). Success: 1 Hit on that Klingon. Failure: a new round starts and the Klingons act first for the rest of the fight.
notes: Book (Captain's Log p. 74): Control is used for remaining stealthy. Book (p. 205): an ambusher 'may score an automatic hit'.

Designer decision (Oct 2026): optional at the fight's opening; best Control + Security in the party rolls; success = 1 free Hit on a chosen Klingon, failure = the Klingons act first this fight. Not in the Actions panel or self ring.
Designer decision (Oct 2026): only a Klingon the ambusher could shoot right now (in one of their weapons' range, with a clear line of fire).

Designer decision (Oct 2026): the chance lasts until anyone attacks (either side); Klingon turns spent moving don't spot the party, so it can close in over several rounds. Offered on party turns only.
Implementation detail (flag for designer): a failed ambush ends the party's current round at once (members yet to act lose that turn) and starts a new round with the Klingons first.
